comments.author: Snipe
comments.body: After Stockholm became a capital, a royal palace was erected, north of the church. Inside, Imperial guards occupied the palace as usual, but the majestic-looking seat at the end of the hallway where i believe the ruler of Stockholm should be sitting is empty. I am unable to step onto the platform the chair is on, much less sit on it myself (heh heh). To invest, one has to go to the town official, like before. Strange.

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: A little piece of trivia! Queen Christina, who we used to be able to see in Stockholm's palace when the Lion of the North expansion went live, can now also be found in Rome, by the second carriage at the far end of town. I think they even changed her old NPC model in Rome to match the new one! Well, it's a small detail, but a nice one. I wonder if we'll ever see her dad in the palace during a specific time period?

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body: Yes, she was already in Rome before, but she looked differently back before the expansion came out. There is also a nice quest chain related to her character in Rome. It starts with the Lovely Flower of the Arena quest from Genoa.
